title: Documents: Meta's internal AI incubator is developing an AI model router, similar to OpenRouter's, to cut costs by sending some AI tasks to lower-cost models (Jyoti Mann/The Information)
summary: Jyoti Mann / The Information: Documents: Meta's internal AI incubator is developing an AI model router, similar to OpenRouter's, to cut costs by sending some AI tasks to lower-cost models — Meta Platforms' internal incubator for AI-powered products and tools is developing a version of the OpenRouter service …
